subtitle.en: What best represents how I work, even when the code isn't public

summary.es: Qué problema resuelve, qué hiciste tú y qué resultado tuvo. Una o dos frases.
summary.en: What problem it solves, what you did and what came out of it. One or two sentences.

summary.es: Juego multijugador en tiempo real: decid palabras a la vez hasta pensar lo mismo. Salas para 2-6 personas con enlace de invitación, reto diario compartible y un bot sin IA de pago (vectores de palabras que aprenden de las partidas reales), medido con su propio banco de pruebas.
summary.en: Real-time multiplayer game: say words at the same time until you think alike. Rooms for 2–6 players with invite links, a shareable daily challenge and a bot with no paid AI (word vectors that learn from real games), measured with its own test bench.
